task: Fix narwhal#735: restrict alloy-logs unauthenticated OTLP receivers (4317/4318) via alloy-logs-ingress-policy so only Grafana (4317) and namespaces carrying narwhal.io/otlp-ingest='true' (dev opted in) can send traces while preserving Prometheus metrics scrape (12345), kubelet probes (169.254.7.127/32 CCNP), and ambient HBONE (15008); document operator opt-in and residual risks; add R377 static/mutation verification.

events.summary: Scope: gitops/resources/network-policies.yaml (alloy-logs-ingress-policy), gitops/resources/dev-namespace.yaml (narwhal.io/otlp-ingest: 'true' on dev), gitops/resources/tenants/README.md, docs/common/{unified-observability-contract,lessons-log}.md, scripts/test/lib/check-alloy-otlp-ingress-optin.py (R377), scripts/test/lib/check-trace-k8s-attributes.py (disambiguate R373 mutation anchor), scripts/test/regression-check-kakao.sh, and this eval trace. Excluded: k8s-monitoring.yaml, 08-2-monitoring.sh, tempo-ingress-policy rules, securityContexts/resources/probes, portal/, and live cluster/VM mutations.

Inspected gitops/resources/network-policies.yaml, gitops/charts/narwhal-apps/templates/k8s-monitoring.yaml, and rendered k8s-monitoring-4.2.0.tgz templates: alloy-logs DaemonSet opens OTLP 4317/4318 and metrics 12345 without any Ingress NetworkPolicy selecting alloy-logs pods (tempo-ingress-policy only selected Tempo), so any pod in any namespace could flood 4317/4318 before memory_limiter (1s check, pre-decode buffers) and delay podLogsViaLoki log shipping in the shared 512Mi/500m process. Enumerated all legitimate ingress callers to alloy-logs: Grafana OTLP self-tracing (4317), opted-in namespaces (4317/4318), Prometheus metrics scrape (12345), kubelet /-/ready probes (169.254.7.127/32 CCNP allow-ambient-kubelet-probes), same-pod config-reloader (localhost:12345), and alloy-operator (Kubernetes API only).

Added alloy-logs-ingress-policy (namespace monitoring, selecting app.kubernetes.io/name=alloy-logs + app.kubernetes.io/instance=k8s-monitoring-alloy-logs) in gitops/resources/network-policies.yaml allowing TCP 4317+15008 from Grafana, TCP 4317/4318+15008 from namespaces labeled narwhal.io/otlp-ingest: 'true', and TCP 12345+15008 from Prometheus while excluding monitoring/waypoint (preserving alloy-logs Service istio.io/use-waypoint: none). Added narwhal.io/otlp-ingest: 'true' to Namespace/dev in gitops/resources/dev-namespace.yaml, documented opt-in procedure in gitops/resources/tenants/README.md and docs/common/unified-observability-contract.md alongside honest residual risks (opted-in namespace floods and platform hostNetwork pod NetworkPolicy bypass), added #735 lessons-log row, disambiguated R373's 4317/15008 mutation anchor, and added R377 (check-alloy-otlp-ingress-optin.py, 13 mutations).
